items.text: Waited far longer than the quoted time, but the prints themselves came out sharp.
Colours came out exactly as expected and the person at the counter was patient with my questions.
Charged noticeably more than the shop down the street for the same size.
Turnaround was about what I expected. Booking a slot online was straightforward.
Nobody acknowledged me for several minutes even though the shop was empty.
Prints were acceptable and the price was about average for the area.
Ready much later than promised and the booking system double-listed my slot, though the staff sorted it out kindly.
